details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: hosts deny fails open on an unresolvable hostname
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70452.patch: treat a "hosts deny" hostname
       token that cannot be forward-resolved as a match in access.c, so the
       connection is refused (fail closed)
     - CVE-2026-70452
   * SECURITY UPDATE: unbounded hash_search() collision work
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-119741.patch: unlink duplicate chain entries
       and skip a block after repeated colliding offsets in match.c, so a
       crafted basis cannot drive excessive CPU use in the delta matcher
     - CVE-2026-119741
